title: Cross-Workspace Target-Local Snapshot Materialization

implementation.scope: Target-local Snapshot materialization from cross-workspace source Version
implementation.path: Source Version[W1] -> Source Snapshot[W1] -> CAS -> Target Workspace[W2] -> Target-Local Snapshot[W2] -> W2.head

validation.materialization_flow: materialize_from_version validates source, materializes CAS content to target workspace, publishes target-local Snapshot with workspace_id=target, updates W2.head
validation.target_independence: Target Snapshot has workspace_id=target; W2.version_head_id unchanged
validation.workspace_isolation: W1 and W2 heads, version_heads, revisions, leases independent
validation.cas_sharing: Immutable CAS content reused across workspaces
validation.atomicity: Materialization fully succeeds or leaves target unchanged
validation.idempotency: Repeated requests safe, retry after failure recovers

coverage: M1: Source validation (version exists, snapshot exists, consistency, ownership, immutability)
M2: Target creation (workspace exists, snapshot created, workspace_id correct, head updated, version_head unchanged)
M3: Content validation (manifest correct, nested tree, empty tree, multiple blobs, CAS sharing, hash consistency, missing/invalid rejection)
M4: Isolation (W1 head/version_head/revision/lease unchanged, W2 version_head unchanged, parallel targets isolated)
M5: Atomicity (failure leaves W2.head unchanged, partial cleanup, publication failure, invalid source/CAS/manifest)
M6: Idempotency (same request repeated, retry after failure, repeated success, no duplicate corruption)
M7: Recovery (cold reopen, snapshot reload, head correctness, CAS readable)
M8: Scenarios (Codex→Cursor, W1→W2, W1→W3, concurrent, multiple executions)

performance_sanity.note: Development-only sanity checks, no performance budget

invariants_verified: Target Workspace.version_head_id unchanged (independent from Snapshot head)
Nested trees and multiple blobs handled
risks: Phase 2 completes materialization; rollback/restore/diff deferred to Phase 3-4
CAS corruption detected by metadata validation, full tree verification deferred
Parallel filesystem materialization not in scope
